_comment: PRE-REGISTERED ACCEPTANCE THRESHOLDS. Every number here is fixed BEFORE the
corresponding measurement is run for the first time. A threshold chosen after seeing
the result is not an acceptance criterion, it is a description of the result.
Changing a number in this file is allowed and is a visible act: it requires a commit
that states what was learned and why the old value was wrong, and the git history of
this file is the record of whether the bar moved to meet a measurement.
The rationale for each number is in eval/README.md. Each is chosen so that the
distance between pass and fail is large compared with the sampling error at the
sample sizes the datasets actually provide.

interval_coverage.on_shortfall: report the observed coverage as the level, rounded down to the nearest 0.05, and change the report's stated level to it

content_invariance.on_partial_pass: if the coarse dataset passes and the brand dataset does not, the record is NOT accepted as written; the claim is narrowed to the domain that passed and the narrowing is stated in the README

off_style_rejection.inversion_reporting: every inversion names both images so it can be looked at
off_style_rejection.scope: smoke test at board size 20, one board per group

_comment: The score is a conformal p-value: the fraction of the reference set that is at
least as unusual as the candidate, under exchangeability. It is a finite-sample
inlier test. It is NOT a probability that the asset is on-brand, and the report
must never render it as a percentage of brand fit.
Its resolution is bounded by the board size. With N references the achievable
p-values are the multiples of 1/(N+1), so a threshold finer than 1/(N+1) can
never fire, whatever the candidate looks like.
score_semantics.min_alpha_permitted: 1/(N+1) for that board, computed and printed by the report
forbidden_renderings: any wording implying calibration to a human decision
score_semantics.on_alpha_below_resolution: refuse the threshold and say so; do not round it up silently

_comment: The classical axes are reported separately and labelled palette, tone and
composition. Nothing currently tests that they measure what their labels say.
An axis that responds to everything is not a decomposition, it is three copies
of one number wearing different names, and it would read as a richer report.
axis_intervention.on_failure: the axis loses its name in the report and is shown as an unlabelled component, or is removed

_comment: Both directions are pre-registered together on purpose. A refusal rule that fires
on everything satisfies the fires-when-it-should criterion completely and is
useless, so the quiet-when-it-should number is what gives the other one meaning.

must_stay_quiet.population: single-look boards of 20 or more, assets drawn from the board's own group

abstention.on_failure: a rule that cannot satisfy both halves is removed rather than tuned, since tuning it against these same cases is fitting to the test

_comment: The falsifier is listed first. If duplicated boards are not measurably more
restrictive at these board sizes, ADR-0005's premise is wrong and the record
should be rejected rather than kept because its correction was implemented.

falsifier_first.claim: a board padded with near-duplicates is more restrictive on held-out on-style assets than a distinct board of the same file count
falsifier_first.min_effect: stated as a rejection-rate difference once the pilot fixes the sampling error, and fixed before the full run
falsifier_first.control: compare at equal n_eff, not equal file count; a smaller board is more restrictive for reasons this claim does not predict

n_eff_tracking.requirement: n_eff on the duplicated board lands closer to the distinct-source count than to the file count

_comment: The CSD repository's own documentation warns that its uploaded checkpoint does
not reproduce the paper's reported numbers. Pinning a revision guarantees the
same answer every time, which is worthless if it is the same wrong answer.
So the pin is accompanied by a reproduction of the published benchmark.
weight_reproduction.on_failure: the weights are not the paper's; either locate weights that reproduce it or drop the published number from every claim in this repository
